about.bioP1: Full Stack Developer with a backend focus — I build systems ranging from AI-powered web scraping to full-scale production platforms.
about.bioP2: At Evento Santo & Doar Digital, I developed a complete LMS: course modules, customizable certificate generation, student area with analytics, and tutor panel with student records and attendance tracking. Additionally, I built modules for events, checkout, waitlists, group bookings, and API integrations with Asaas and WhatsApp API.
about.bioP3: In my personal projects, I pushed further: a B2B CRM in Go with an AI pipeline using Google Gemini, asynchronous workers with Redis, and a custom WhatsApp gateway — from scratch to Docker Compose with 7 microservices.
about.bioP4: Stack: Go, PHP, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python. Hands-on IoT experience — ESP32, sensors, and hardware deployment in the field.
